sections.text:
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed every 3000 hours of operation. This procedure was applied in 
ABU QIR power plant since 1985 and the final draft is issued in May 2005.

The first draft is initiated and 
tested by eng. Mohamed El-Touny, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Sadek general director of Abu Kir PS, 
approved by eng. Aly Anwar 
El-Fayoumy Head Sector of Abu Kir PS, 
ومصدقة 
بواسطة المهندس. منى أحمد الشرقاوي: رئيس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة WDEPC 
القطاع.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل
Disconnect the 6 kv circuit breaker and tagged it out
Put or switch the earth cable for motor

sections.text:
Change the oil for both outlet fan 
 bearing and inlet fan bearing ( using telious oil 32 ) as follows:
 * Dismantle the outer cover of the bearing
 * Dismantle the lower plug to remove the old oil
 * Dismantle the upper part of the bearing and 
 inspect for roller Iub ring and assemble it 
 again
 * Cleaning the oil indication level glass
 * Dismantle the upper plug and fill the new oil, 
 tighten and fit lower plug 
 * Measure the winding isolation

items:
General cleaning and inspection of metal fixed parts and painting with 
 anti oxide clean the rode & blades using hard brush and paint it with anti 
 oxide paint

Change the oil for both outlet fan 
 bearing and inlet fan bearing ( using telious oil 32 ) as follows:
 * Dismantle the outer cover of the bearing
 * Dismantle the lower plug to remove the old oil
 * Dismantle the upper part of the bearing and 
 inspect for roller Iub ring and assemble it 
 again
 * Cleaning the oil indication level glass
 * Dismantle the upper plug and fill the new oil, 
 tighten and fit lower plug 
 * Measure the winding isolation

sections.text: Maintenance of coupling between motor and fan

items: Dismantle the outer covers of bearing and coupling
Dismantle the two half casings covers of the coupling
Remove the two spring layers. And remove the old grease
General cleaning for the coupling
Measure the distance between the hubs and readjust if necessary
Measure the misalignment and readjust if necessary
Fill up the grooves and space between hubs with grease
ضع طبقتي الزنبرك واملأهما بالشحم

Assemble the coupling two half casings with their gasket over the spring 
 and hubs and assembly of the half casing
Assembly of the outer cover of the coupling and bearing

sections.text:
Maintenance of suction air damper (control 
damper)

items: Inspect the blades
Clean & inspect the protective air screen and change if necessary

Grease the bearing dampers axis (Grease darnia quantity 30 gm / 
 bearing)
Grease the bearings of dampers blades main axis
Grease the dampers blades axis
Grease the dampers opening connecting rods and pins
Grease the bearing of the dampers axis
Inspect the oil of the dampers piston glasses
Adjust the damper opening / closing indicators position

sections.text:
Test the fan back into service after maintenance 
procedures on the motor, the control and protection circuits, and the 6 KV 
Circuit Breaker in coordination with the shift engineer.
